title: Future of the Indians and sign-off
summary: Cahn says the Indians or something like them will last forever; the host thanks him and plays Professor Longhair's Big Chief.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: You think so? Do you think the Indians, how long, do you think they'll still be around?
I think either the Indians or something similar to the Indians will be around forever.
